data.one_liner: GraphQL WebSocket link for executing queries, mutations, and subscriptions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebSocket link for GraphQL clients to execute operations and manage real-time subscriptions over web sockets. Supports auto-reconnection and multiple websocket sub-protocols like graphql-ws and graphql-transport-ws.
use_when: You need GraphQL subscriptions in your Flutter or Dart app
You are using the gql ecosystem and need a WebSocket transport layer
avoid_when: You only need standard HTTP-based queries and mutations without real-time updates
You are not using the gql client architecture
strengths: Supports both graphql-ws and graphql-transport-ws protocols
Built-in autoReconnect and automatic resubscription handling
weaknesses: The WebSocketLink class has some known issues documented in the project repository
Requires using the broader gql link ecosystem
